children: Quanex Building Products CORP reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $501.85M and diluted earnings per share of $0.58, compared with $495.27M and ($6.04) in the prior-year quarter; net income was $26.5M versus a loss of ($276.01M) a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Basic and diluted earnings (loss) per common share”.
Revenue growth modest: net sales rose about 1% for the quarter and 2% year-to-date, driven by price and surcharge adjustments that offset lower volumes.
Segment performance: Custom and Extruded Solutions showed strength with volume and pricing gains; Hardware experienced a slight volume decline.
Product and market momentum centered on fenestration and cabinet components, supported by energy-efficiency trends and retrofit demand.
Operational actions: post-Tyman realignment into Hardware, Extruded, and Custom Solutions continues, alongside tariff and supply-chain mitigation efforts.
